trello.name: Configure Stripe Subscription Tiers
trello.desc: Owner: Alex/Team. Task: Set up the three subscription tiers in Stripe with the following pricing and features: Basic ($29/month, basic AI model selection tool access, limited features), Pro ($49/month, additional features, priority support), and Enterprise ($99/month, all features, custom support, integration options). Ensure these are correctly reflected in the Stripe dashboard for integration.

trello.name: Implement Frontend Checkout with Stripe Elements
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Task: Implement the checkout process using Stripe Elements. The form must be customizable, secure, and match the app's design. Handle potential errors gracefully (e.g., invalid card details, insufficient funds). Include a clear comparison of features for each tier and a prominent checkout button. Add a tooltip or help icon explaining plan change policies. Deadline: Part of the 2-week initial integration phase.

trello.name: Update Pricing Page
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Task: Update the website's pricing page to reflect the new Basic, Pro, and Enterprise subscription tiers. Ensure the design is clean and straightforward, allowing users to easily understand what they get with each plan.

trello.name: Develop User Dashboard for Subscription Management
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Task: Build the user dashboard functionalities including: displaying current plan details and billing info, options to upgrade/downgrade/cancel subscriptions, access to invoices and payment history, and a way to update payment methods. The dashboard must reflect subscription status in real-time and notify users of changes (upgrades, payment failures). Integrate with the backend API to ensure real-time updates.

trello.name: Integrate Stripe API for Backend Subscription Management
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor. Task: Integrate Stripe's API on the backend to handle creating and managing subscriptions, processing payments (successful and failed), and setting up webhook handlers. Ensure the backend can create subscriptions upon payment completion and process payments correctly.

trello.name: Implement Webhook Handlers
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor. Task: Set up and test webhook handlers for specific events: 'invoice.payment_succeeded' (confirm payments, activate/continue subscriptions), 'invoice.payment_failed' (notify users, prompt payment info update, send email notification), and 'customer.subscription.deleted' (manage cancellations, update access rights, offer re-subscription). Ensure these handlers update the system correctly.

trello.name: Create and Execute Test Plan
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor (lead), Jordan (support). Task: Prepare a detailed test plan covering manual and automated tests. Test the entire subscription flow from sign-up to billing to management. Include test scenarios for payment failures, cancellations, and edge cases. Ensure all errors are handled with clear user notifications. Deadline: Week 3 (testing phase).

trello.name: Document API Endpoints and Webhook Handlers
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor. Task: Document all API endpoints and webhook event handlers to facilitate future maintenance and troubleshooting.

trello.name: Create User Documentation and Help Section
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan/Taylor. Task: Develop clear user documentation, including a help section or FAQ, covering how to manage subscriptions, access invoices, handle issues, and answer common questions about the new subscription model.

trello.name: Schedule Follow-up Meeting
trello.desc: Owner: Alex. Task: Schedule a follow-up meeting for next week to review progress and address any blockers or issues arising from the integration work.
